verdict.rationale: Brex documents its own virtual cards: Bill Pay can create a virtual card instantly, in one click, to pay a vendor, and cards can be issued and bulk-created via API and integrations. A community user also praises the 'dynamic credit card generator'. However, nothing explicitly shows a card locked to a single merchant or vendor, so the isolation guarantee in the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented merchant/vendor locking for virtual cards, explicit SaaS-subscription card workflows, and evidence that a compromised card cannot be used at other merchants.
